infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Alertify.au Companion uses your location when you opt in to nearby hazard alerts, check fire danger, save a watch address, or choose a trip starting point.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you opt in on the Trip Watch screen, Alertify.au Companion uses location in the background during an active Trip Watch to check hazards near you.
